# 🏁 Welcome to the Block — FED-EDU Discussions

You made it. Pull up a chair (or a milk crate, we don't judge).

This is the front porch of the whole operation. Everything here runs on one belief:

> **You are not "less than" because your laptop is a 2011 Dell with a cracked screen. You're not behind because you're starting at 30 or 45. The only thing that matters is the next commit.**

## 🗺️ Where to Post What

| You want to... | Post in | How it works |
|---|---|---|
| Say who you are | **Q&A → Introduce Yourself** | Drop your city + what you're trying to build |
| Ask ANY question (yes, that one) | **Q&A** | No stupid questions. Zero. |
| Show off what you built | **Show and tell** | Even if it's "just a button." ESPECIALLY if it's just a button. |
| Share a hustle lead | **Ideas** | Someone needs a website? Post it, someone eats. |
| Talk life, grief, wins, Ls | **General** | Brothers here. This is a safe porch. |
| Call out gatekeeping | **General** | Screenshot it, post it. We handle ours. |

## 🧭 First-Time on GitHub? Do This in Order

1. Read **Introduce Yourself** — see the kind of brothers already here.
2. Post your own intro. Two lines is enough: *"Atlanta. 31. Trying to build my first website so I can leave this warehouse job."*
3. Read the [README](https://github.com/fedpromptly/FED-EDU) — the Manifesto.
4. Follow **INSTALL.md** — pick the setup path that matches your hardware (phone-only counts).
5. Come back and post your first "I got it running" in Show and tell. That's your first dap.

## ⚖️ The Six Rules (Short Version)

Full law lives in [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Porch rules:

1. **No stupid questions.** The question you're scared to ask is the one five brothers are PMing about.
2. **No untranslated jargon.** You say "API"? Somebody's lost. Translate it or link the Urban Dictionary.
3. **Celebrate attempts, not just wins.** "It broke and here's what I learned" is a post.
4. **Zero gatekeeping.** Nobody here is better than anybody. Ahead ≠ better.
5. **Ownership stays with builders.** Your project is YOUR project. We don't claim forks.
6. **Protect the younger brothers.** They're 14 and watching us. Act like somebody's uncle, because you are.

## 🚨 If Somebody's Struggling (Not Code)

This porch handles more than bugs. If a brother posts something heavy — locked up, homeless, hungry, hopeless:

- **Don't scroll past.** A single "you're not alone, I've been there" can change a night.
- Real talk over links, but know the numbers: **988** (US crisis line), **116 123** (UK Samaritans). Full list in SUPPORT.md.
- Never post somebody's personal business outside the thread. What's said on the porch stays on the porch.

## 💰 Money Rules on the Porch

- **Rate floors exist** (see PRICING.md). If you see somebody quoting $75 for a whole website, pull them aside — respectfully — and show them the floor. We starve alone or eat together.
- Hustle leads get posted in **Ideas**, not DMs-first. Brothers vouch for brothers.
- Nobody charges another brother to *learn*. Teaching is free here. Always.

## 🎟️ How to Eat (Raffle Tickets)

Every real contribution earns tickets for the refurb-PC raffles:

| Move | Tickets |
|---|---|
| Merged PR (pushed real code/fix) | 5 |
| Completed guide/course | 10 |
| Welcome-agent verified helpful answers | 1-3 |
| Built a whole blueprint sandbox | 15 |

Drawings are livestreamed, ledger is public (`physical-raffles/earn-tickets.json`), winners get the machine shipped. Full rules: [physical-raffles/](../physical-raffles/).

## 🧊 Housekeeping

- **Beats? Memes? Bar-for-bar?** Friday thread in General. Keep it fun, keep it clean enough for the 14-year-olds reading over our shoulder.
- **Spam / scam / crypto-bro nonsense** gets removed same-day. This block has an economy, and it's built on code.
- **Mods = Elders.** They're not cops, they're uncles. If one pulls you aside, it's love, not a shot.

---

*This readme greets every brother who clicks the Discussions tab for the first time. If it made you feel welcome, that's the point. Now go read the Manifesto and get to work — the block is watching, and the block is proud of you already.*
